description.value: Black Rock Oceanfront Resort is a luxury oceanfront property perched on a dramatic headland above the Pacific Ocean in Ucluelet, surrounded by the Wild Pacific Trail and the rugged rocky coast of West Vancouver Island. The resort offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes or full kitchens, gas fireplaces, soaking tubs, and furnished balconies. On-site amenities include the Drift Spa with outdoor hot tubs, a seasonal plunge pool, and direct trailhead access to the Wild Pacific Trail—making it a scenic base for exploring the Pacific Rim region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The resort website is live and detailed, confirming the property is open and matching OSM contact details (address 596 Marine Drive, phone 250-726-4800). No mention of bike storage, bike wash, tools, laundry, drying areas, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content, so all bike-related criteria remain null. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed via website text per the rules, so Wi-Fi is also null.
concerns: Website lists a toll-free reservations number (877-266-2559) not present in OSM; OSM only has the local contact number (250-726-4800), which the website confirms as the direct contact line.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating oceanfront resort in Ucluelet with a live website, confirmed contact details, and clear public accessibility.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort has a dedicated outdoor dog wash station noted on the pets page, but this is explicitly for rinsing off dogs and should not be assumed to serve as a bike wash.
